name: n_std
description: balanced metabolites: log-normal bound exp(mu +/- n_std * sigma) of ln(C) over the conditions (3 contains all data; 2 excluded six measured values)

name: balanced_mode
description: bound rule of the balanced metabolites (log_std or data_range)

name: cofactor_mode
description: bound rule of the imbalanced metabolites / cofactors (log_std or data_range)

name: cofactor_slack
description: fractional widening of the cofactor data range on each side (data_range mode)

name: floor
description: strictly positive lower floor of every concentration bound (mM)

name: drain_widen
description: free drains: data min/max widened by this fraction of the span on each side

name: pi_lo
description: C_pi lower bound (mM); Pi is never measured so the literature range is used
